metadata.model_availability_synced_via: client.models.list() (Gemini API) on 2026-08-13 — confirms model existence/aliases only; this endpoint does not return pricing. gemini-robotics-er-1.5, imagen-3, and gemma-3 (models[]) plus the gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview index entry were marked deprecated after confirming they no longer appear in the live model list. gemini-3-pro-image-preview intentionally stays removed even though it is still live (per explicit instruction). 22 live models (e.g. gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-flash-latest, gemini-pro-latest, gemma-4-31b-it) remain unadded pending official pricing figures — see conversation history for the full list.

conventions.null: feature not available for this tier / model combination
conventions.0: available at no charge (free tier active)
conventions.price_fields: always number type, unit defined by the sibling billing_unit field

context_tiers.gt_200k: prompt total token count > 200,000 (all tokens billed at this rate)

conventions.grounding_free_allowance_unit: RPD (requests per day) — uniform across all models
conventions.image_output_schema: single billing_unit=USD_per_image; token_count field documents token consumption for reference only — it does NOT change the billing_unit
conventions.caching_read_ratio: cache read price = input price × ratio (documented per model for verification)
conventions.gemini_3_7_flash_note: gemini-3.7-flash has scheduled 2x pricing on 2027-01-01 (no timezone given on the pricing page; assumed UTC 00:00, matching this file's other date-cutover conventions) across standard_paid, batch_paid, flex_paid, and priority_paid (cache_storage too). Current (through 2026-12-31) prices live under the plain tier names; post-cutover prices live under a '_2027_01_01' tier suffix (e.g. standard_paid_2027_01_01) — PriceManager switches automatically once 'now' reaches the cutover. flex tier pricing is identical to batch (flex_paid mirrors batch_paid exactly, per the source page). Grounding (search/maps) has no published date-based change and is carried over unchanged into the 2027 tier.

metadata.model_string_normalization: Strip leading 'models/' prefix, then lowercase. GeminiProvider: s.removeprefix('models/').strip().lower()
metadata.lookup_key_pattern: {model_string}#{tier}#{direction}#{modality}[#{context_tier|resolution|variant}]  |  tier = standard_free | standard_paid | batch_free | batch_paid  |  direction = input | output | cache_read | cache_storage | grounding_search | grounding_maps | image_gen
metadata.update_note: Updated from official Google AI Gemini API pricing page. Runtime PriceManager currently consumes lookup text token prices; multimodal/tool prices are retained for reference and future billing support.
